info.name: Resolve AI API
info.description:
Resolve AI backend v1.0.0: Detect → Understand → Recommend → Act → Measure → Report (synthetic data).

1. Import this collection and an environment (Local or Railway) from docs/postman/.
2. Run "0. Demo journey" with the Collection Runner: each step saves the IDs the next one needs.
3. The other folders are a reference for every endpoint, with saved example responses.

Envelope: { data, meta? } / { error: { code, message, details? } }. Rate limits: AI 20/min, writes 120/min, reads 600/min.
Full guide: docs/API.md. OpenAPI: {{baseUrl}}/openapi.json · interactive docs: {{baseUrl}}/docs

item.name: 0. Demo journey (run in order)
item.description: The whole loop on {{journeyCustomerId}}: hand-off → reply → reason → recommendation → approval → simulated window → outcome → measure → report → Copilot. Needs a freshly seeded database (`npm run db:seed`) and simulation enabled. To run it again without re-seeding, set journeyCustomerId to another customer that is awaiting a reply (e.g. LR-29623).

item.name: 1. Hand off an ask to Orange (voice call)

request.description: Resolve AI records the hand-off; Orange's channel contacts the customer.
Demo only. The reply is classified by AI (keyword fallback without an API key).
